description: The ordinary hardfork: one chain, one build at a time. Four stablenet producers run the pre-fork build to the block before boho, every node is stopped, and all four come back on the post-fork build — same chain, same databases, same work, a different executable. The fork then activates and swaps govMinter to v2, which is what proves the restarted network crossed rather than merely bounced. The go-wemix cases prove the other shape, where two sets of nodes run at once and production changes hands.
